description.value: JAK's Beer Wine Spirits is a neighbourhood liquor retailer with 10 locations across Greater Vancouver, stocking wine, craft beer, and premium spirits. The brand emphasises knowledgeable, relationship-driven service and offers online ordering with home delivery through third-party platforms. A stop here could allow a touring cyclist to restock beverages, though no cycling-specific services are advertised.

address.value: 8555 Sea Island Way, Unit 135, Richmond, BC V6X 0A8
